answer: Issue perishable task-leases: each epoch the protocol mints a scarce supply of single-use work tickets — the nectar — each bound at claim time to exactly one responding identity and expiring within a single pulse of the network clock. To earn, an agent must hold a lease and spend real metered compute before it decays. Idle sybils cannot just wander the ledger farming rewards: every extra identity needs its own perishable lease and its own live work inside the window, so an attacker pays linearly in scarce leases and genuine compute, never a one-time mint of masks.
